decisions.rationale: The complete numeral directly attests ten. Just listed and group expand the contextual referent and are not additional words inside this head.
The demonstrative refers back to the ten, explicitly resumed as quoted them. Preserve the quoted pronoun itself without assigning the explanatory group-of-ten wording twice.
The complete LA marks the referent of the naming question and is realized by this prepositional relation. This is local grammar, not a lexical reference noun.
The complete interrogative expression directly supports why; do not split its bound genitive or conflate it with the conditional question formula.
The complete established technical compound directly attests path of action. Its internal action/path members are unique within this first singular occurrence.
LAS is the full action member within the technical parent; curated deed and glossary action evidence remain distinct tiers.
LAM directly attests path, the complete first member in English despite reversed source order.

The question formula is supported by reference if it is asked and the current complete naming question. Its auto-mined correct perception gloss is unrelated and is not treated as HGM attestation of this formula.
YID directly supports thought and denotes the mental domain of the three actions. It is not the later separate SEMS PA mental movement.
The genitive relationship is realized with in involved with thought. Involved is left as the English relational expansion; this particle does not become a lexical involvement noun.
GSUM directly supports three. The earlier GSUM PA organizational ordinal is a different occurrence and is not equated with first of all.
This independent LAS is the action introduced as mental movement. The following or deed is an English synonymous restatement of that same source noun, left unbanked.
The complete technical SEMS PA directly attests mental movement. This is the mental action whose expression takes a path, not a generic thought duplicated onto YID.
The complete JUG PA has expressed among its HGM equivalents, matching the local realization of mental movement. Bound genitive/relative support is left outside this lexical predicate.
First independent LAM supplies paths in the explanation of the three. By which is supplied relative/instrumental support and is not part of the path head.
The first full copular form predicates path status of the three. It owns are after thought, not the later is auxiliary within expressed.
DANG continues the argument with the additive Moreover. It does not own the separate English and linking the asyndetic body/speech pair.
LUS directly attests body and names the bodily domain of the seven.
NGAG directly attests speech and names the verbal domain alongside body.

GI supplies the second with relationship. The full GI entry also explicitly lists involved with; the tight particle choice leaves the expanded involved outside rather than denying that broader evidence.
BDUN directly supports seven, the combined bodily/verbal group.
This separate LAS states that the seven are action themselves. Deeds is the English alternative noun for the same source occurrence, not another LAS token.
The separate YIN predicates action status of the seven and owns are after speech. It is not reassigned to the later implicit path-status copula.
Second SEMS PA owns the second mental movement in the seven-actions clause, with its own lexical occurrence.
Second JUG PA owns the second expressed, ending the path-status clause of the seven.
Second independent LAM owns paths after as well as, distinct from the concluding complete compound.
YANG adds path status to the already stated action status of the seven. This complete additive English phrase belongs to that second predication; earlier KYANG/emphasis is left unbanked.

Keep the full causal copular construction as a phrase with the concluding Thus. Its exact master awaits HGM and has reference causal/conditional material; the whole preceding dual-status argument supports this local discourse consequence, not a claimed literal glossary gloss.
The last source compound names the conclusion paths of action. It owns the first plural complete compound after Thus, not the separate phrase in the appended next-part heading.
The concluding parent contains one LAS/action member. This is distinct from both earlier free-standing action nouns.
The concluding parent contains the full plural paths member. No possessive particle or supplied article is added at member depth.

omissions.english: first of all; The fourth major part
omissions.reason: The source third ordinal introduces this organizational topic. English first of all organizes the derivation and the appended fourth major part introduces following material. Neither is a secure third exponent; retain this organizational mismatch as unbanked, not an arbitrary first/third alignment or a false lexical absence null.

omissions.english: the expression; is used; The name derives first of all from the fact that; they are all
omissions.reason: The naming formula is distributed across expression/is used and the later name derivation/conclusion. Its complete entry has an unrelated mined every living creature gloss and quotation-reference evidence. No exclusive atom is selected merely from leftover wording; the full technical names remain banked.

omissions.tib: bound genitives after the two jug pa occurrences; la after yin; earlier kyang
omissions.english: by which; through which; is; themselves; and between body and speech
omissions.reason: Relative/instrumental and copular support is distributed or supplied; no separate bound genitive is attached outside its parent. Earlier KYANG emphasizes action status whereas later YANG supplies the additive path-status phrase. Themselves is not securely a standalone KYANG exponent, and the source body/speech pair has no intervening DANG.

omissions.english: or deed; or deeds; to the group of ten just listed; involved; articles and supplied participants
omissions.reason: These are synonymous restatements and explanatory support around secure heads. The two deed alternatives each repeat their own LAS/action; they do not provide additional Tibetan nouns. Tight KYI/GI with leaves the involvement expansion outside.

omissions.english: The fourth major part in our presentation of the "paths of action" concerns the ways in which one loses, and then regains, his most basic virtue. *********
omissions.reason: The complete physical English appends a forward transition and asterisks after the present naming argument. C16:882 preserves the same Tibetan/current body but appends a different heading and introduction. This supports treating the trailing text as apparatus of an already registered class, not as alternative current-body exponents or a newly filed error.
